fullContent:
Brahmi Thailam (Oil) 
 Introduction 
 Brahmi Thailam is an effective herbal oil which aids in treating headache, dizziness, hair fall and lack of sleep. It relieves tension and anxiety. It is a revitalizer. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Brahmi (Bacopa monneiri) 
 Amalaki (Emblica officinalis) 
 Til taila (Sesame oil) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 All ingredients are added to til oil and prepared by oil paak method. 
 Indications 
 
 Hair fall 
 Anxiety 
 Tension 
 Headache 
 Sleeplessness 
 Depression 
 Schizophrenia 
 
 Contraindications 
 There are no known side effects. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
